messages:
jordan_k: deploy-bot flagged canary failure in eu-west1 on v2.3.9-hotfix (kv-cache pressure spike). 2% elevated 5xx on embeddings path, errors started at +72s into canary. requesting expedited approval to skip remaining canaries and push the hotfix to prod. link: https://internal/ci/4201234567/logs
deploy-bot: Canary percent: 5% -> errors spike @ 72s. Rollout paused automatically. Suggested actions: rollback canary, extend canary, or skip canary with 2 approvers. Command options: `/deploy proceed --skip-canary` or `/deploy rollback --version v2.3.8`
maria_ops: quick ask — do we have realtime eval diffs? are model outputs regressing or just infra 5xx?
li_eng: infra. logs show LRU eviction thrash in kv-store causing high tail latency. model responses time out, so 5xx. not a quality regression.
sam_release: timeline? when was this rolled to eu-west1 canary? any overlap with the autoscaler change earlier?
jordan_k: canary started 03:14 UTC (72s ago). autoscaler patch rolled at 02:58 UTC, but that was EU-edge only. correlation looks likely.
oncall-ops: if infra, prefer pin to dedicated pool in eu-west1 and forward deploy. Can we pin to dedicated GPUs for v2.3.9 to avoid multitenant churn?
li_eng: yes we can. quick command: `kubectl patch deployment inference-eu --patch '{"spec":{"template":{"metadata":{"annotations":{"redwood/pool":"dedicated-eu-small"}}}}}'` — will force new pods on dedicated pool.
maria_ops: approve skip-canary if we pin to dedicated pool and monitor for 10m with alert gating. need 2 approvals + oncall ok.
sam_release: +1 for skip-canary with pin. also add release note blurb so support can triage: "Hotfix v2.3.9: KV eviction tuning to reduce tail latency in eu-west1; emergency pin to dedicated capacity during rollout."
jordan_k: adding release note and head commit: `git@repo:hotfix/kv-evict-2026`
deploy-bot: To proceed with skip-canary require 2 human approvals. Current approvals: none. Actions: `/deploy proceed --skip-canary --pin=dedicated-eu-small` or `/deploy rollback`
oncall-ops: oncall-ops here — approve. will watch alerts and escalate to SRE if any spikes. :eyes:
maria_ops: maria_ops here — approve. please include 10m autoscale-free monitoring window and rollback plan: `rollback -> v2.3.8` within 15m if errors >1% sustained.
sam_release: sam_release — noted. adding release note to the doc and pinging support. :thumbsup:
jordan_k: initiating deploy now with pin and skip-canary. command run: `/deploy proceed --skip-canary --pin=dedicated-eu-small --meta "hotfix:kv-evict"`
deploy-bot: Received deploy command from jordan_k. Scheduling rollout to prod eu-west1 with dedicated-eu-small. Canary skipped per approvals. Estimated rollout completion: +2m. Monitoring window: 10m.
deploy-bot: Stage: creating pods on dedicated-eu-small -> success. Stage: routing traffic -> 40% -> 100%.
li_eng: watching KV eviction metrics; looks stable so far. tail latency down 35% after pod replacement.
oncall-ops: alerts quiet. still monitoring error rate; current 5xx at 0.4% (down from 2%).
maria_ops: good. keep the 10m window and then we can mark hotfix closed and update release notes in prometheus.
jordan_k: thanks all. I'll update the incident log and add a postmortem note if we see recurrence.
deploy-bot: Rollout succeeded. Final status: success. Deployed v2.3.9 -> prod (eu-west1) pinned to dedicated-eu-small. Monitoring window cleared at +10m.
sam_release: follow-up: schedule a tech debt ticket to revisit autoscaler behavior under eviction pressure. assign li_eng.
li_eng: on it. creating ticket RD-9123.
maria_ops: closing approvals thread. great cross-team response. :clap:
